entries.headline: PlayStation Portal Midnight Black Japan-only model launches December 10
entries.summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment Japan Asia announced a Japanese-language-only PlayStation Portal model in Midnight Black for Japan. It launches December 10 for 39,980 yen, includes one month of PlayStation Plus Premium and adds internal storage reserved for future functionality that has not yet been detailed.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays Sony Interactive Entertainment Japan Asia's announcement and confirms the model, language restriction, date, price, subscription benefit and added storage.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 9 at 9:52 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: ALL.Net and Aime partially recover as several Bandai Namco arcade games resume trial operation
entries.summary: Sega Fave issued an update after unauthorized access affected ALL.Net and Aime. With some functions restored, several Bandai Namco arcade games began resuming trial operation; as of 9:00 AM JST on November 8, Sega products remained under maintenance with no confirmed restart time.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminicogamer report explicitly relays updates from Sega Fave and Bandai Namco on partial recovery, trial operations and the November 8 status.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 8 at 2:51 PM Beijing time; the operational status is stated as of 9:00 AM JST.

entries.headline: My Hero Ultra Rumble Mobile announced with pre-registration now open
entries.summary: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced My Hero Ultra Rumble Mobile, retaining the three-player teams, eight-team structure and 24-player maximum while restricting matchmaking to mobile players. The free-to-download iOS and Android game has in-app purchases and no announced release date.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminicogamer report explicitly relays Bandai Namco Entertainment's announcement and confirms the mobile identity, player count, matchmaking scope, platforms and pre-registration.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 9 at 6:34 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: PULSE Elevate wireless speakers delayed after a manufacturing issue is found
entries.summary: PlayStation Blog announced that PULSE Elevate wireless speakers have been delayed after quality testing found a manufacturing issue. The Japan launch had been set for November 12 at 37,980 yen; no new date has been announced. The speakers support PS5, PlayStation Portal, PC and Mac.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminicogamer report directly relays the PlayStation Blog announcement and confirms the reason, original date, price, supported platforms and absence of a new date.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 9 at 8:25 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Warhammer Blood Bowl full release slips to early 2027
entries.summary: Slitherine confirmed at Dominion Days that Warhammer Blood Bowl will no longer reach full release in 2026 and is now planned for early 2027. Testing continues with a new 10-match Arena mode, while Tomb Kings and Bretonnians will be added to the base game for free.
entries.verification: The opened PC Gamer report describes Slitherine's Dominion Days announcement and confirms the revised window, ongoing test, Arena mode and two free factions.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 9 at 8:45 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Star Wars: Zero Company developer Bit Reactor reportedly lays off more staff
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that multiple Bit Reactor developers said they had been laid off. The studio had begun a partial return-to-work process in October; the available evidence provides neither a headcount for this round nor a formal company statement, so no scale or cause is inferred.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms public layoff reports from multiple developers and provides the earlier return-to-work context; the fixed snapshot includes no formal statement or headcount for this round.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 9 at 9:56 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Ocarina of Time's Switch 2 remake gives the Mask of Truth an inner-thoughts feature
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that the Switch 2 remake released on November 5 adds a feature to the Mask of Truth that lets players hear residents' inner thoughts. Some lines have drawn attention for revealing another side of the characters; specific dialogue is omitted here to avoid additional spoilers.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the Switch 2 remake's date, platform and new inner-thoughts mechanic without requiring dialogue beyond the fixed snapshot.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 8 at 1:03 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Gakuen Idolmaster adds Kanae Himuro as a producible idol on November 16
entries.summary: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced that Kanae Himuro will join Gakuen Idolmaster as a producible idol on November 16, voiced by Ayaka Abe. The game is available on PC via DMM GAMES, iOS and Android.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Bandai Namco Entertainment's announcement and confirms the character, implementation date, voice actor and current platforms.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 8 at 7:21 PM Beijing time.
